# book_bookable_type (Resource)

The bookable_type records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) Display name of the bookable type.
- `owner_id` (String) Organisation that owns the bookable type.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free form notes about the bookable type.
- `external_id` (String) Caller supplied identifier from an external system.
- `icon` (String) The library icon the bookable type is shown with: a glyph name, text or a raw svg
- `parent_id` (String) Parent bookable type id; omit or null for a root type
